card.name: Hard-c sound starting a new term
card.fires_on: The letter C or the pieces "oc" and "yc" that start the hard-c part of a term. It fires just after a break, as in a heading, a list item, "/dev", or partway through a drug name like Adrenocortical or Oxycodone.

modes.label: Capital C opening a new item
modes.description: A lone C or c begins a new name or heading right after a list break or drug class.

modes.label: Inside c-words in drug names
modes.description: The "oc" or "yc" piece partway through adrenocortical or oxycodone type names.

modes.label: Device path letter c
modes.description: The c in NetBSD paths such as /dev/cd0a.
